messages:
andre: Packaging heads-up: preparing signed OCI bundle for Private/VPC window tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. target tag: v1.12.0-priv. please confirm pins and rollback criteria.

miriam: noted. I’ll run checksum + cosign after packaging. ETA 40m.

packaging-bot: build started for v1.12.0-priv (x86_64, aarch64). artifact: registry.redwood-internal/private/v1.12.0-priv.tar.gz

andre: change window is small — we need clear fallback to private registry push + installer-only rollback. no database migrations in this release.

kyle: ops runbook draft: rollback if installer preflight fails on >5% of hosts OR post-install healthcheck <90% across canary cohort. also abort if cosign verification fails on any node.

ops-runbook: adding thresholds: latency regressions >25% for >10m during canary => auto-fail to previous pinned image. docs: https://confluence.redwood/release/runbook#v1.12.0

jen: release notes ready. callouts: airgap transport manifest changed (submanifest v2), updated KMS key rotation note. link: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/v1.12.0-priv

andre: pin policy: for Private installs we pin the installer image and submanifest SHA; if we need to roll forward we must publish a new signed submanifest and re-run the offsite escort. no loose tag fallthrough.

miriam: cosign sign step queued. KMS alias: projects/redwood/keys/release-signer-prod. will post sig + pubkey once done.

signer-bot: cosign: payload digest sha256:abc123def4567890...

signer-bot: cosign signature uploaded to s3://redwood-signatures/private/v1.12.0-priv.sig, signed-by: miriam (kms:key-03).

andre: checksum snippet for transport team:
```
sha256sum v1.12.0-priv.tar.gz
# expected: abc123def4567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890
```

kyle: transport plan: offsite courier will pick up media at 03:00 UTC window. primary plan is escort -> airgap delivery. fallback is push to customer-managed private registry (instructions included in runbook).

jen: note in release notes about fallback: customers will receive alt-artifacts and instructions for registry pull; ops will notify customer success if fallback is used.

andre: deploy-bot please schedule the canary rollout and pin on successful preflight.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: 03:30 UTC -> 50 hosts for 15m. auto-rollback on healthcheck failures per ops-runbook thresholds.

miriam: quick heads-up: cosign verification locally on a test node passed. verifying installer hash now.

packaging-bot: manifest generation complete. submanifest id: sm-2026-03-20-001. includes preflight hooks and rollback hooks.

andre: final checklist before handoff to transport:
- signatures present (cosign) : miriam ✅
- checksums match manifest : kyle ✅
- runbook and release notes published : jen ✅
- canary schedule in deploy-bot : deploy-bot ✅

kyle: transport informed, ETA ack from courier by 02:45 UTC. I’ll post proof-of-custody once sealed.

jen: I'm posting the short release note blurb in #announcements right after canary passes.

ops-runbook: reminder: if we hit soft-failure (single region anomaly) we will pause canary and escalate to oncall, but not automatically rollback unless thresholds breached.

andre: thumbs up. if anything blocks, @miriam @kyle ping here and we’ll hold the window. otherwise proceed. :thumbsup:

miriam: signed and pushed signatures. packaging-bot uploaded artifacts to staging-s3.

kyle: courier ack received 02:46 UTC. manifest sealed.

deploy-bot: canary starting 03:30 UTC now — monitoring enabled.

andre: leaving this thread open for any rollback decisions. will log final artifacts in the release ticket after window.

jen: (post) canary passed 03:46 UTC. no regressions. prepping announcement.

andre: closing thread, rolling signature to release ticket #REL-1123 and marking as delivered to transport. thanks all. :rocket:
